description: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy resources that restrict pod-to-pod and pod-to-external communication. Default-deny ingress/egress with explicit allowlists.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: Pod only reachable from explicitly allowed sources
Compromised pod cannot reach arbitrary cluster services

verification.method: Check for default-deny NetworkPolicy in namespace

remediation.name: default-deny ingress and egress NetworkPolicy with per-service allowlisting

steps.description: Apply a default-deny ingress NetworkPolicy to the target namespace (blocks all inbound traffic to pods unless explicitly allowed by another policy)
steps.command:
kubectl apply -n <namespace> -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-ingress
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
EOF

steps.description: Apply a default-deny egress NetworkPolicy to the target namespace (blocks all outbound traffic from pods unless explicitly allowed)
steps.command:
kubectl apply -n <namespace> -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-egress
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
EOF

steps.description: Allow DNS egress for all pods in the namespace (required for service discovery to function under default-deny egress)
steps.command:
kubectl apply -n <namespace> -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-dns-egress
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector: {}
    ports:
    - protocol: UDP
      port: 53
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 53
EOF

steps.description: Allow ingress to a specific service from authorized source pods (replace <app_label> with the target pod label and <source_label> with the client pod label)
steps.command:
kubectl apply -n <namespace> -f - <<'EOF'
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-<app_label>-ingress
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: <app_label>
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: <source_label>
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: <service_port>
EOF
